## Summary

Describe the recovery behavior or maintenance problem this change addresses.

## Validation

- [ ] Core tests pass.
- [ ] Package integration test passes.
- [ ] Browser tests pass, or the change cannot affect browser behavior.
- [ ] Documentation and changelog are updated when the public interface changes.

## Safety

- [ ] Fixtures and reports contain no credentials, production URLs, request bodies, or response bodies.
- [ ] Fault injection remains bounded and verifies that the requested fault occurred.
